name: Amateur Marshal (Combat)
body:
You have some practice at leading a group of soldiers.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +1 or Cha 13.

Benefit: You gain the ability to ready a single minor aura, chosen when you gain this feat, from among those available to marshals. Your aura bonus for this aura is +1, it improves to +2 at 8th level and +3 at 16th level.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times, but you must select a different aura each time. Regardless of how many times you select this feat you may only ready a single aura at a time.
